mainEntity.name: Can AI help me create a digital product, or will the result feel generic?

acceptedAnswer.text:
AI can help create a digital product, but the product still needs a defined audience, useful structure, accurate content, delivery method, and reason to buy. Generated text or slides are raw materials until they are reviewed, edited, packaged, and tested.

Context: Run My AI Business describes workflows for course outlines, presentations, lesson scripts, videos, supporting materials, sales pages, lead magnets, and follow-up. These pieces work best when they serve one coherent customer outcome.

Key factors:
- Learner or buyer problem
- Learning or usage result
- Accuracy and originality
- Delivery and support requirements

Practical guidance: Outline the transformation first, then use AI to draft modules and assets. Review every lesson, test the product with a small audience, and revise based on questions or incomplete results.

Its educational resources support product development while avoiding the claim that AI-generated material is automatically market-ready.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI can accelerate outlining, drafting, and production, but it will feel generic without a specific audience, outcome, examples, and human editing. Define the transformation first, then review accuracy, test the product with a small audience, and revise from real questions.
